text:
Alex H: Quick sync — we got a red flag from the field: SI partner GatewayX is getting leads for accounts in our EU marketplace region. Who owns the follow-up?

Maria C: We agreed bizdev owns first outreach for marketplace-sourced leads, then handoff to SI if they request integration help. But GatewayX expects the SI to own pipeline ops for named accounts they bring.

Samir P: Clarify: are these leads Marketplace listings or joint co-sell referrals? small difference for SLAs.

Alex H: They came from a marketplace demo request form (marketplace -> partner selection step). Vendor tag shows GatewayX.

Jordan (SI Ops): GatewayX's MSA expects them to be primary contact for technical discovery, but Redwood should still control contract routing. We need an account mapping rule: if partner introduced and account ARR < $250k -> SI handles initial POC; else Redwood SDRs do initial qualification.

Kevin BD: +1 to a simple threshold. Also propose a 48h ownership window: BizDev/SDR reaches out within 48h or partner can claim. Keeps momentum.

Maria C: Operationally, we need a mapping table in Confluence (region, partner, ARR_threshold, owner). Can someone draft? I can start EU and APAC.

Samir P: I'll add SI risk flags (NDA required, data residency, on-prem HW). For GatewayX, flag = on-prem HW possibility.

Alex H: For joint announcements: if partner asks for co-marketing we require a 2-week prep and product sign-off. Call this "announce gating". Add an exceptions column for strategic enterprise deals.

Jordan (SI Ops): Proposal for routing logic (pseudo):
- marketplace_lead && partner_tagged -> assign_to: bizdev_primary
- if no outreach in 48h -> partner_allowed_to_claim=true
- if account_ARR < threshold(partner) -> auto-assign to SI_field_team

Kevin BD: Can we add a human review step for border cases? e.g., ARR within 20% of threshold should go to a quick triage channel (#partnerships-triage).

Maria C: I'll draft the Confluence page and include an intake form sample for partners to self-certify "introduced lead" with timestamped proof.

Samir P: Also add an audit column: partner_claim_proof_url, and a required screenshot of marketplace lead card.

Alex H: Great. Action items: Maria — create page + intake template by Friday. Jordan — update SI Ops playbook with ARR threshold examples. Kevin — loop in legal on GatewayX MSA carveouts. Samir — add risk flags. I'll create a quick triage channel and invite this group. :thumbsup:

announce-bot: Reminder — Partnership sync scheduled tomorrow 10:00am PT (link: https://cal.redwood/integrations).
